input.content: Retry recovery that freezes the first attempt's payload: the recovery record captured values at creation and skipped the provider apply once status was "applied". The contract allowed retrying a failed save with the same ID and edited values ("success means latest submitted values are active"). A failure after the apply (e.g. the receipt write) left the old values active while the retry reported success. When the provider is idempotent, re-apply the latest submitted values on every non-completed retry and update the stored values. Don't skip the apply because of an intermediate status.
